I have received the following faculties
For EEE363 Aqu, EEE154 JSA and MAT361 ISR for these following courses I was seeking valuable insight of my seniors who have attended them.
I just wanted to know whethere the faculties are able to teach the courses in depth and are able to make it easy to comprehend, I also wanted to know whether enough course materials are shared. Furthermore if it was possible to share the format of their assesment test and the general format of the ques… See more

For MAT361 under ISR sir you must attend the classes regularly as not only he teaches extremely well, but some key points in theory he'll say during lectures you have to keep in mind for mid and final as he makes extremely tricky questions there, where not understanding the theory properly would render you unable to answer them correctly.
But quizzes are easy and they come directly from either slides or the maths he will suggest each chapter.
Although he suggests maths per chapter, he will tell you about two books, where one is bit harder than the other one, he suggests maths from the easier one, but you can also practice from the other book he would mention, it'd help you in mid and final.
He'll also provide a formula sheet which you can use in mid and final so even if you forget formulas during exams you would have no problem.
